replies.body:
Hey muzz99,

I was the one who banned you of course and I asked a senior staff member to check if you had any other accounts that were banned. The one which came up was dudesn, according to you that is your brother. Since we don't have any proof of that being your brother or any knowledge of that I had to ban you. If you're able to come into teamspeak one day and show us proof that you have a brother and that he was banned on avicus then you will be unbanned.
